title: PRO 1 yakuniy loyiha va imtihon
goal_uz: Dars oxirida PRO 1 modulini to‘liq takrorlab chiqasiz: ishga ariza to‘plami (CV, xat, intervyu), telefon, e-mail va yig‘ilish tili, kundalik professional vaziyatlar, xato va talaffuz takrorlash, hamda yakuniy testdan o‘tasiz.

scenes.title: PRO 1 yakuniy loyiha va imtihon
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! 24 ta darsni orqada qoldirdik. Bugun — PRO 1 modulining yakuni: butun modulni tez takrorlash, yakuniy loyiha va imtihon strategiyasi. Ishga ariza to‘plami — CV, xat va intervyu; telefon, e-mail va yig‘ilish tili; kundalik professional vaziyatlar; hamda xato va talaffuz takrorlash. Oxirida o‘n besh savollik yakuniy test kutib turadi. Xotirjam bo‘ling — hammasi darslarda o‘tgan material.
scenes.say: Welcome to the final PRO 1 lesson. Today we review the whole module, prepare your final project, and sit the final test.
scenes.say_uz: PRO 1 ning yakuniy darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun butun modulni takrorlaymiz, yakuniy loyihangizni tayyorlaymiz va yakuniy test topshiramiz.

scenes.title: PRO 1 xaritasi: o‘tgan yigirma to‘rt dars
scenes.say_native: Modulimiz xaritasini eslaylik. Professional til — uchrashuvlar, e-mail, telefon; ishga ariza — CV, xat, intervyu; hikoya qilish — hook va STAR; bahslashish — pozitsiya va dalil; madaniyat — odob va murojaat; hamma joyda xato tuzatish va talaffuz — urg‘u, bog‘lanish, kuchsiz shakllar. Bugun har mavzudan bitta naqsh ajratamiz va yakuniy loyihaga tayyorlanamiz.
scenes.say: Here is our PRO 1 map: conversation, email, the job application set, storytelling, debate and culture — plus error correction and pronunciation throughout. Today we revisit each block and get your final project ready.
scenes.say_uz: Mana PRO 1 xaritasi: sozlashuv, e-mail, ishga ariza to‘plami, hikoya, munozara va madaniyat — hamda xato tuzatish va talaffuz. Bugun har bir mavzuni qaytadan ko‘rib chiqamiz va yakuniy loyihangizni tayyorlaymiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
scenes.say_native: Avval strategiya. O‘qish bo‘limida: avval savollarni o‘qing, keyin matnni ko‘z yugurtirib kerakli so‘zlarni qidiring — so‘zma-so‘z o‘qish shart emas. Har savolga taxminan bir daqiqa ajrating; qiyin savolda qotib qolmang — belgi qo‘ying va orqaga qayting. Javoblarni aniq yozing. Bu strategiyalar B2 First va IELTS uchun ham birday ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Strategy: read the questions before the text, then skim for keywords. Give each question about a minute. Never get stuck — mark it and return. Write answers clearly. These habits work for any English qualification.
scenes.say_uz: Strategiya: avval savollarni o‘qing, keyin matnni kalit so‘zlar uchun ko‘z yugurtirib chiqing. Har savolga taxminan bir daqiqa bering. Hech qachon qotib qolmang — belgi qo‘ying va qaytib keling. Javoblarni aniq yozing. Bu odatlar har qanday ingliz tili imtihonida ishlaydi.

scenes.title: 1-bosqich: xatolar takrorlash

examples.t: I want to learn English. (want + to)

scenes.say_native: Birinchi bosqich — odatiy xatolar. Artikllar: birinchi marta — a/an, keyin — the, umum — hech narsa. Kelishuv: does — III shaxs birlikda, do — qolganlar — ikkalasidan keyin asosiy shakl. „Did“ dan keyin asosiy shakl: „I didn't finish“. „Want, need, would like“ har doim „to“ bilan. Stative fe’llar — „like, know, want“ — davom zamonda ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: A quick error tour: first time a or an, second time the. Does in the third person, then the base form. Did plus base form — never did finished. Want, need and would like always take to. Stative verbs never take the continuous.
scenes.say_uz: Tez xato sayohati: birinchi marta a yoki an, ikkinchi marta the. Uchinchi shaxsda does, keyin asosiy shakl. Did plyus asosiy shakl — hech qachon did finished emas. Want, need va would like har doim to oladi. Stative fe’llar hech qachon -ing olmaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna: o‘nta xato gapni tuzating
board: Fix: I am doctor → I am a doctor
Fix: I am agree → I agree

examples.t: I have gone to the conference.

scenes.say_native: Namuna. Odatiy xato xatidagi tuzatishlar: „I am doctor“ → „I am a doctor“; „I have went“ → „I have gone“; „She don't like“ → „She doesn't like“; „I can to help“ → „I can help“; „He is agree“ → „I agree“; „Explain me“ → „Explain to me“; „on Monday in 5 pm“ → „on Monday at 5 pm“; „I didn't finished“ → „I didn't finish“; „He explain me“ → „He explained it to me“. Bu xatolar PRO 1 ning yuragi.
scenes.say: Ten classic fixes: I am a doctor. I have gone. She doesn't like it. I can help. I agree. Explain it to me. On Monday at five. I didn't finish. I agree with you. He explained it to me.
scenes.say_uz: O‘nta klassik tuzatish: I am a doctor. I have gone. She doesn't like it. I can help. I agree. Explain it to me. On Monday at five. I didn't finish. I agree with you. He explained it to me.

scenes.title: Xatolarni toping va tuzating
scenes.say_native: Mashq qiling. To‘rtta xato gapni tuzating: „I am doctor“, „She don't like green tea“, „I didn't finished the report“, „Explain me the rule“. Har birida qaysi qoida buzilganini ayting. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Fix the four sentences: I am doctor. She don't like green tea. I didn't finished the report. Explain me the rule.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta gapni tuzating: I am doctor. She don't like green tea. I didn't finished the report. Explain me the rule.

scenes.title: Javoblar: xatolar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. „I am a doctor“ — noaniq artikl. „She doesn't like green tea“ — III shaxsda does + asosiy shakl. „I didn't finish the report“ — did + base form. „Explain it to me“ — explain + to + kishi. Shu to‘rtta qoida sizni yozishdagi eng odatiy xatolardan xavfsiz qiladi.
scenes.say: I am a doctor — article. She doesn't like — agreement. I didn't finish — did plus base. Explain it to me — to before the person.
scenes.say_uz: I am a doctor — artikl. She doesn't like — kelishuv. I didn't finish — did plyus asosiy shakl. Explain it to me — kishidan oldin to.

scenes.title: 2-bosqich: talaffuz takrorlash

examples.uz: I needed a plan — -ed /ɪd/ deb o‘qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi bosqich — talaffuz. Kuchsiz shakllar: „do“ — /də/, „to“ — /tə/, „of“ — /əv/, „a“ — /ə/ — yordamchi va predloglar urg‘usiz qoladi. -ed oxirlar: „worked“ — /t/, „played“ — /d/, „needed“ — /ɪd/. Bog‘lanish: „I_agree“, „the_evidence“. Bayonda ohang pasayadi, savolda ko‘tariladi. Uch muvaffaqiyatli odat: sekinroq boshlang, kalit so‘zga urg‘u bering, oxirini tushiring.
scenes.say: Weak forms: do, to, of, a — /də/, /tə/, /əv/, /ə/. The -ed endings: worked is /t/, played is /d/, needed is /ɪd/. Link your words: I_agree, the_evidence. Fall for statements, rise for questions.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchsiz shakllar: do, to, of, a — /də/, /tə/, /əv/, /ə/. -ed oxirlar: worked /t/, played /d/, needed /ɪd/. So‘zlaringizni bog‘lang: I_agree, the_evidence. Bayonda ohang pasayadi, savolda ko‘tariladi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz mashqi
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz mashqi. Birinchi: „worked“, „played“, „needed“ — qaysi birida -ed /ɪd/ o‘ladi? Ikkinchi: „I agree“ ni bitta oqimda bog‘lang. Uchinchi: „I see it differently“ jumlasini sokin, pasayuvchi ohangda ayting. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Worked — /t/. Played — /d/. Needed — /ɪd/. I_agree. I see it differently.
scenes.say_uz: Worked — /t/. Played — /d/. Needed — /ɪd/. I_agree. I see it differently.

scenes.title: Javoblar: talaffuz
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. „Needed“ — -ed /ɪd/, chunki fe’l /d/ bilan tugaydi. „Worked“ — /t/, „played“ — /d/. „I_agree“ bitta oqimda aytiladi. „I see it differently“ — sokin, pasayuvchi ohang. Shu uch talaffuz odati inglizchani tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say: Needed is /ɪd/ because the verb ends in /d/. Worked is /t/, played is /d/. Link I_agree. Drop the tone on I see it differently.
scenes.say_uz: Needed — /ɪd/, chunki fe’l /d/ bilan tugaydi. Worked — /t/, played — /d/. I_agree ni bog‘lang. I see it differently da ohangni tushiring.

scenes.title: 3-bosqich: CV tuzilishi
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi bosqich — CV. Britaniyada „CV“, AQShda ko‘pincha „résumé“. Tuzilishi: shaxsiy ma’lumot — ism, kontakt; ikki jumlalik qisqa taqdimot; ish tajribasi — teskari xronologik, natijalar bilan; ta’lim; ko‘nikmalar; tavsiyalar. Har bandda raqam: „Reduced onboarding time by 30%“. CV bir sahifadan oshmasin; xatolarni tekshiring.
scenes.say: A CV: personal details, a two-line summary, experience in reverse order with numbers, education, skills, references. Keep it to one page. Reduced onboarding time by thirty percent — that is the kind of line you want.
scenes.say_uz: CV: shaxsiy ma’lumot, ikki qatorlik qisqa taqdimot, teskari tartibda tajriba raqamlar bilan, ta’lim, ko‘nikmalar, tavsiyalar. Bir sahifadan oshirmang. Reduced onboarding time by thirty percent — shunday satrlar kerak.

scenes.title: Namuna CV parchasi

examples.t: Customer success manager with 4 years managing enterprise accounts; cut churn by 18%.
examples.uz: 4 yillik enterprise mijozlar tajribasiga ega mijoz-muvaffaqiyat menejeri; churnni 18 foizga kamaytirgan.

scenes.say_native: Namunaga qarang. Bir qatorlik taqdimot: „Customer success manager with 4 years managing enterprise accounts; cut churn by 18 percent“ — kimligingiz va eng katta natijangiz bir qatorda. Tajriba bandida harakat + natija. Skills: „fluent English, CRM tools, stakeholder communication“. Mana shu zichlikdagi CV o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: Customer success manager with four years managing enterprise accounts; cut churn by eighteen percent. Led onboarding for forty accounts and reduced time-to-first-value by a third. Skills: fluent English, CRM tools, stakeholder communication.
scenes.say_uz: 4 yillik enterprise mijozlar tajribasiga ega mijoz-muvaffaqiyat menejeri; churnni 18 foizga kamaytirgan. Qirqta accountni moslashtirishni boshqarib, birinchi qiymatga yetish vaqtini uchdan birga qisqartirgan. Ko‘nikmalar: ravon ingliz tili, CRM vositalari, manfaatdor tomonlar bilan muloqot.

scenes.title: CV mashqi: natija satrini yozing
scenes.say_native: Mashq qiling. O‘zingizning bitta yutuqingizni CV natija satri sifatida yozing: harakat fe’li + nima qilganingiz + raqam. Masalan: „Reduced report time from 3 days to 1“. Raqamingiz bo‘lmasa ham, taxminiy son yoki foiz yozing. Javobingizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Write one achievement line: action verb plus task plus number. Reduced report time from three days to one. Led a team of six. Saved two hours a week.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta yutuq satri yozing: harakat fe’li plyus vazifa plyus raqam. Hisobot vaqtini uch kundan bir kunga qisqartirdim. Oltita kishilik jamoani boshqardim. Haftasiga ikki soat tejadim.

scenes.title: Javoblar: CV
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Yaxshi satr uchta elementdan iborat: harakat fe’li (led, reduced, built), nima qilganingiz, va raqam yoki foiz. CVni har ish e’loniga moslang — e’londagi so‘zlarni ishlating. Bir sahifa, aniq va xatosiz — bu uch shart CVni professional qiladi.
scenes.say: A winning line: action verb, task, number. Led, reduced, built — plus a figure. Tailor your CV to each job advert, keep it to one page, and proofread twice.
scenes.say_uz: G‘olib satr: harakat fe’li, vazifa, raqam. Led, reduced, built — va bitta ko‘rsatkich. CVingizni har ish e’loniga moslang, bir sahifada tuting va ikki marta tekshiring.

scenes.title: Cover letter tuzilishi

examples.t: I am writing to apply for the customer success role.

scenes.say_native: Cover letter — CVdan ajralmas ilova xati. Uch qism: birinchisi — nima uchun yozayotganingiz va qaysi lavozim; ikkinchisi — nega mos ekaningiz — bitta kuchli misol bilan, raqam bilan; uchinchisi — uchrashuv so‘rab yakunlash. Xat qisqa bo‘lsin: uch–to‘rt paragraf, bir sahifa. CVni takrorlamang — to‘ldiring: CV faktlar, xat sizning hikoyangiz.
scenes.say: A cover letter has three parts: why you write, why you fit — with one example and a number, and a polite close asking for an interview. Three short paragraphs, one page, no CV repetition.
scenes.say_uz: Cover letter uch qismdan iborat: nima uchun yozyapsiz, nega mos ekaningiz — bitta misol va raqam bilan, va uchrashuv so‘raydigan yakun. Uch qisqa paragraf, bir sahifa, CVni takrorlashsiz.

scenes.title: Namuna cover letter parchasi

examples.t: Last year I cut churn by 18% by rebuilding our onboarding.
examples.uz: O‘tgan yili onboardingni qayta qurib, churnni 18 foizga qisqartirdim.

scenes.say_native: Namuna parcha: „I am writing to apply for the Customer Success Manager role at Meridian. In my current role I rebuilt onboarding and cut churn by 18 percent — your focus on reducing churn matches that directly. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can do the same for Meridian. I look forward to hearing from you.“ — ochilish, moslik, yopilish — ellikka yaqin so‘z.
scenes.say: I am writing to apply for the Customer Success Manager role at Meridian. In my current role I rebuilt onboarding and cut churn by eighteen percent. I would welcome the chance to discuss the role. I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_uz: Men Meridian kompaniyasida Mijoz-muvaffaqiyat menejeri lavozimiga ariza bermoqchiman. Hozirgi lavozimimda onboardingni qayta qurib, churnni 18 foizga qisqartirdim. Lavozimni muhokama qilish imkonini bajonidil qabul qilaman. Javob kutaman.

scenes.title: Cover letter mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mashq qiling. O‘zingiz uchun uchta jumla yozing: ochilish — „I am writing to apply for…“; moslik — bitta raqamli yutuqingiz; yakun — uchrashuv so‘rash. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I am writing to apply for the role. In my last position I increased retention by fifteen percent. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.
scenes.say_uz: Men lavozimga ariza bermoqchiman. Oxirgi lavozimimda ushlab qolishni 15 foizga oshirdim. O‘z hissamni qo‘shish imkonini munozara qilishdan xursand bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Javoblar: cover letter
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ochilish — lavozimni aniq nomlang. MOSlik — bitta raqamli misol yetadi; CVni takrorlash kerak emas. Yakun — „I look forward to hearing from you“ — professional va ishonchli. Xatni avval o‘zingiz o‘qib chiqing va jo‘natishdan oldin ikki marta tekshiring.
scenes.say: Open by naming the role. Fit with one number-backed example. Close with: I look forward to hearing from you. Proofread twice before sending.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilishda lavozimni aniq nomlang. Moslikni bitta raqamli misol bilan ko‘rsating. Yakunlang: I look forward to hearing from you. Jo‘natishdan oldin ikki marta tekshiring.

scenes.title: Intervyu: STAR usuli

examples.t: The client had threatened to leave, so I mapped the process…
examples.uz: Mijoz ketishni tahdid qilgan edi, shuning uchun men jarayonni xaritadim…

scenes.say_native: Intervyu yuragi — STAR: vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija. Savol: „Tell me about a difficult problem you solved“. Masalan: vaziyat — „Our largest client was about to leave“; vazifa — „I had to rebuild onboarding fast“; harakat — „I mapped the process and fixed two bottlenecks“; natija — „Churn fell 18%“. STAR hikoyasi o‘zbek madaniyatida ham yaqin — endi intervyuga moslang.
scenes.say: STAR: situation, task, action, result. Our largest client was about to leave — situation. I had to fix onboarding fast — task. I mapped the process and removed two bottlenecks — action. Churn fell eighteen percent and they renewed — result.
scenes.say_uz: STAR: vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija. Eng katta mijozimiz ketish arafasida edi — vaziyat. Onboardingni tez tuzatishim kerak edi — vazifa. Men jarayonni xaritadim va ikkita tor joyni olib tashladim — harakat. Churn 18 foizga tushdi va ular yangiladilar — natija.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: intervyu parchasi
board: Topic: a difficult problem at work
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglang. Intervyu oluvchi Bekzoddan ishda hal qilgan qiyin muammosi haqida so‘raydi. Tinglab, STAR qismlarini tuting: vaziyat qayerda, harakat qaysi, natija nima. Shuningdek, Bekzod javobining ohangini eshitishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Interviewer: Bekzod, tell me about a difficult problem you solved at work. Bekzod: Sure. Our biggest client threatened to leave over late deliveries. I mapped the process, found two bottlenecks and fixed them within a month. Interviewer: And the result? Bekzod: They stayed — we signed a two-year renewal. My main strength is staying calm under pressure.
scenes.say_uz: Intervyu oluvchi: Bekzod, ishda hal qilgan qiyin muammoingiz haqida ayting. Bekzod: Albatta. Eng katta mijozimiz yetkazib berish kechikishlari sababli ketishni tahdid qildi. Men jarayonni xaritadim, ikkita tor joyni topdim va ularni bir oyda tuzatdim. Intervyu oluvchi: Natija-chi? Bekzod: Ular qolishdi — ikki yillik yangilanishni imzoladik. Mening asosiy kuchli tomonim — bosim ostida tinch qolishim.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Bekzod qanday muammoni tasvirlaydi? Ikkinchi: u birinchi nima qiladi? Uchinchi: natija nima bo‘ladi? To‘rtinchi: uning asosiy kuchli tomoni nima? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What difficult problem did Bekzod describe? What did he do first? What was the result? What does he say his main strength is?
scenes.say_uz: Bekzod qanday qiyin muammoni tasvirladi? U birinchi nima qildi? Natija nima bo‘ldi? U asosiy kuchli tomoni nima deb aytadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bekzod eng katta mijozning kechikishlar tufayli ketish xavfi haqida gapiradi. U birinchi jarayonni xaritalaydi, ikkita tor joyni topib bir oyda tuzatadi. Natija — ikki yillik yangilanish. Uning kuchli tomoni — bosim ostida tinchlik. STAR: u vaziyatni, harakatni va natijani aniq ajratdi — intervyuda aynan shu kerak.
scenes.say: Bekzod describes the biggest client nearly leaving over late deliveries. He maps the process and fixes two bottlenecks. The result: a two-year renewal. His main strength: staying calm under pressure.
scenes.say_uz: Bekzod eng katta mijozning kechikishlar tufayli ketishiga yaqin qolganini tasvirlaydi. U jarayonni xaritalaydi va ikkita tor joyni tuzatadi. Natija: ikki yillik yangilanish. Uning kuchli tomoni: bosim ostida tinch qolish.

scenes.title: 4-bosqich: telefon tili

examples.t: Good morning, this is Dilnoza calling from Bright & Co.
examples.uz: Xayrli tong, Bright & Co dan Dilnoza qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapdi.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi bosqich — telefon. Qo‘ng‘iroq tili: o‘zingizni tanishtiring — „Good morning, this is Dilnoza Karimova from Bright and Co“; so‘rang — „Could I speak to Mr Lewis, please?“; u yo‘q bo‘lsa — „Could I leave a message?“; raqamlar bitta-bittadan o‘qiladi va „double“ ishlatiladi: „double two, double three“. Xotirjam ovoz, aniq raqamlar va oxirida raqamni takrorlatish — uchta odat.
scenes.say: Good morning, this is Dilnoza from Bright and Co. Could I speak to Mr Lewis, please? Could I leave a message? Please ask him to call me back before lunch. That's zero seven seven zero — one, two, double three.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, Bright and Co dan Dilnoza. Mister Lewis bilan gaplasha olsam bo‘ladimi? Xabar qoldira olsam bo‘ladimi? Iltimos, tushlikdan oldin qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilishini so‘rab qayting. Nol yetti yetti nol — bir, ikki, uch uch.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: ofisga qo‘ng‘iroq
board: Topic: a message for Mr Lewis
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglang. Dilnoza Meridian Supplies ofisiga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Tinglab, yozib boring: u kimga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi, uni topadimi, qanday xabar qoldiradi va qaysi raqamni aytadi. Raqamlarni inglizcha tinglash muhim — ular tez o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: Receptionist: Good morning, Meridian Supplies. Dilnoza: Good morning, this is Dilnoza Karimova, Bright and Co. Could I speak to Mr Lewis, please? Receptionist: I'm afraid he's in a meeting until eleven. Could I take a message? Dilnoza: Yes, please — ask him to call me back before lunch. Receptionist: Of course. The number? Dilnoza: Zero seven seven zero, one, two, double three. Receptionist: Zero seven seven zero, one, two, double three. I'll make sure he gets it. Dilnoza: Thank you so much. Goodbye.
scenes.say_uz: Qabulxona: Xayrli tong, Meridian Supplies. Dilnoza: Xayrli tong, Bright and Co dan Dilnoza Karimova. Mister Lewis bilan gaplasha olsam bo‘ladimi? Qabulxona: Afsuski, u soat o‘n birgacha yig‘ilishda. Xabar olib qo‘yaymi? Dilnoza: Ha, iltimos — tushlikdan oldin menga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilishini so‘rang. Qabulxona: Albatta. Raqam? Dilnoza: Nol yetti yetti nol, bir, ikki, uch uch. Qabulxona: Nol yetti yetti nol, bir, ikki, uch uch. Men uni yetkazaman. Dilnoza: Juda rahmat. Xayr.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Who does Dilnoza want to speak to?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Dilnoza kim bilan gaplashmoqchi? Ikkinchi: nima uchun gaplasha olmaydi? Uchinchi: qanday xabar qoldiradi? To‘rtinchi: qaysi raqamni aytadi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Who does Dilnoza want to speak to? Why can't she speak to him? What message does she leave? What number does she give?
scenes.say_uz: Dilnoza kim bilan gaplashmoqchi? U nima uchun gaplasha olmaydi? U qanday xabar qoldiradi? U qaysi raqamni aytadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Dilnoza mister Lewis bilan gaplashmoqchi; u soat o‘n birgacha yig‘ilishda. Xabar: tushlikdan oldin qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilsin. Raqami: nol yetti yetti nol, bir, ikki, uch uch. Telefon suhbatining uch kaliti: aniq tanishtirish, aniq xabar, raqamni sekin aytish — va oxirida takrorlatish.
scenes.say: Dilnoza wants Mr Lewis. He's in a meeting until eleven. The message: call back before lunch. The number: zero seven seven zero, one, two, three three.
scenes.say_uz: Dilnoza mister Lewisni xohlaydi. U soat o‘n birgacha yig‘ilishda. Xabar: tushlikdan oldin qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qiling. Raqam: nol yetti yetti nol, bir, ikki, uch uch.

scenes.title: E-mail tili: ochilish, asosiy qism, yakun
board: Opening: Dear Ms Clark / Dear all,

examples.t: Dear Ms Clark, I hope you are well.
I look forward to your reply. Kind regards,

scenes.say_native: E-mail uch qatlam: ochilish — „Dear Ms Clark“ yoki „Hi Emily“ — tanishingizga qarab; asosiy qism — har paragrafda bitta fikr; yakun — „I look forward to hearing from you“ + „Kind regards“. Mijozga „Yours faithfully“; ismli tanishga „Kind regards“. Mijozga „at your earliest convenience“, „ASAP“ emas. Imzo: ism, lavozim, kontakt.
scenes.say: Opening: Dear Ms Clark, or Hi Emily, depending on how well you know them. Body: one point per paragraph, short sentences. Close: I look forward to hearing from you, then Kind regards. Signature block with your name, role and contact.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilish: Dear Ms Clark yoki Hi Emily — tanishingizga qarab. Asosiy qism: har paragrafda bitta fikr, qisqa gaplar. Yakun: I look forward to hearing from you, keyin Kind regards. Imzo ma’lumotlari: ism, lavozim va kontakt.

scenes.title: Namuna e-mail

examples.t: Please find attached the March invoice.

scenes.say_native: Namuna e-mail: „Dear Ms Whitmore, I hope you are well. Please find attached the March invoice, due 15 April. Could you confirm receipt when you have a moment? If anything needs adjusting, I will fix it the same day. Kind regards, Dilnoza Karimova, Bright and Co.“ — ochilish, vazifa, iltimos, sokin yopilish, imzo.
scenes.say: Dear Ms Whitmore, I hope you are well. Please find attached the March invoice, due the fifteenth of April. Could you confirm receipt when you have a moment? If anything needs adjusting, let me know. Kind regards, Dilnoza Karimova, Bright and Co.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli xonim Whitmore, ahvolingiz yaxshimi? Ilovada mart schyoti — 15-aprelgacha. Vaqtingiz bo‘lsa, qabul qilganingizni tasdiqlay olasizmi? Biror narsani o‘zgartirish kerak bo‘lsa, ayting — o‘sha kuni tuzataman. Hurmat bilan, Dilnoza Karimova, Bright and Co.

scenes.title: E-mail yozish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mashq qiling. Hamkasbingizga qisqa e-mail yozing: ochilish — bitta salom; asosiy qism — bitta vazifa va bitta oxirgi muddat; yakun — „I look forward to your reply“ va lavozimingiz bilan imzo. Javobingizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda o‘qing.
scenes.say: Hi Emily — I hope you are well. Could you send me the Q2 sales figures by Thursday? I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Aziz.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Emily — ahvolingiz yaxshimi? Iltimos, Q2 sotish raqamlarini payshanbagacha yuborishingiz mumkinmi? Javobingizni kutaman. Hurmat bilan, Aziz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: e-mail
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ochilish qisqa bo‘lsin. Asosiy qism — bitta vazifa, bitta muddat, iltimos shaklida. Yakun — „Kind regards“ yoki „Best regards“ va to‘liq imzo. E-mailda uch narsa kerak: aniqlik, qisqalik, muloyimlik. Bir xat — bitta maqsad.
scenes.say: Short greeting, one task, one deadline, a polite close, and a full signature. Clarity, brevity, courtesy — one email, one purpose.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa salom, bitta vazifa, bitta muddat, muloyim yakun va to‘liq imzo. Aniqlik, qisqalik, muloyimlik — bir xat, bir maqsad.

scenes.title: Reading: e’lonni o‘qish strategiyasi
board: Skim for gist → scan for numbers
scenes.say_native: O‘qish strategiyasi. Avval e’lonni tez ko‘z yugurtirib chiqing — nima lavozim, qaysi kompaniya. Keyin savollarni o‘qing va kerakli raqamlar va so‘zlarni matndan topib belgilang — barcha javoblar matnda. Raqamlar va sanalar har doim aniq belgilangan bo‘ladi. Bu usul imtihonda va real ish hayotida ham ishlaydi — ish e’lonlarini shunday o‘qiymiz.
scenes.say: Reading strategy: skim for the gist first — which role, which company. Then read the questions and scan the text for keywords, numbers and dates. Every answer lives in the text.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qish strategiyasi: avval matnni tez ko‘z yugurtirib chiqing — qaysi lavozim, qaysi kompaniya. Keyin savollarni o‘qing va matndan kalit so‘zlar, raqamlar va sanalarni topib boring. Har javob matnda.

scenes.title: E’lonni o‘qish va javob bering
scenes.say_native: Vaqtli o‘qish topshirig‘i. E’lonni tinglang, keyin to‘rtta savolga javob bering: lavozim nomi nima? Mijozlar portfeli necha hisobdan iborat? Sayohat qancha tez-tez talab qilinadi? Ariza oxirgi muddati qachon? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Customer Success Manager. We are looking for an experienced customer success manager to join our team. You will manage a portfolio of forty enterprise accounts, onboard new clients and reduce churn. Requirements: three-plus years in customer success, excellent written English, travel twice a month. Apply with your CV and cover letter by the thirtieth of November. Questions: which role is this? How many accounts? How often the travel? What is the deadline?
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz-muvaffaqiyat menejeri. Biz jamoamizga tajribali mijoz-muvaffaqiyat menejerini izlayapmiz. Siz qirqta yirik mijoz portfellarini boshqarasiz, yangi mijozlarni onboarding qilasiz va churnni kamaytirasiz. Talablar: mijoz-muvaffaqiyatda uch yildan ortiq tajriba, mukammal yozma ingliz tili va oyiga ikki marta sayohat. CV va qisqa cover letteringizni o‘ttiz noyabrgacha yuboring. Savollar: qaysi lavozim? Nechta hisob? Sayohat qanchalik tez-tez? Oxirgi muddat qachon?

scenes.title: Javoblar: e’lon
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Lavozim: Customer Success Manager. Portfel: qirqta yirik hisob. Sayohat: oyiga ikki marta. Oxirgi muddat: o‘ttiz noyabr. E’lonlarda chiroyli gaplar emas — talablar va raqamlar muhim; aynan shularni qidiring.
scenes.say: The role: Customer Success Manager. Forty enterprise accounts. Travel: twice a month. Deadline: the thirtieth of November. Numbers and requirements are the heart of a job advert.
scenes.say_uz: Lavozim: Customer Success Manager. Qirqta yirik hisob. Sayohat: oyiga ikki marta. Oxirgi muddat: o‘ttiz noyabr. Raqamlar va talablar — ish e’lonining yuragi.

scenes.title: 5-bosqich: kundalik professional vaziyatlar
board: Feedback: Could you give me feedback?

examples.t: Could you walk me through the process?

scenes.say_native: Beshinchi bosqich — kundalik vaziyatlar. Ishdagi oddiy uchrashuv formulasi: avval small talk — bir-ikki jumla; keyin vazifa — „The main point today is…“; yakun — „So we agreed…“. Xato uchun: „I apologise for the delay“. Fikr so‘rash: „Could you give me some feedback?“. Vaqt so‘rash: „Could we push the meeting to Thursday?“. Bu iboralar — kundalik ish tilining sharti, ularni yodlang.
scenes.say: Daily formulas: small talk first, then the task, then the close. I apologise for the delay. Could you give me some feedback? Could we push the meeting to Thursday? The main point today is…
scenes.say_uz: Kundalik formulalar: avval small talk, keyin vazifa, keyin yakun. I apologise for the delay. Could you give me some feedback? Could we push the meeting to Thursday? The main point today is…

scenes.title: Xato: juda to‘g‘ri-to‘g‘ri buyruq
board: ✗ Send me the file now. → ✓ Could you send me the file today?
✗ I want to know the price. → ✓ Could you tell me the price?
✗ You are wrong. → ✓ I see it differently.

examples.t: Could you possibly send the file today?

scenes.say_native: Professional ishda buyruq emas, iltimos. „Send me the file now“ inglizchada ham qo‘pol — „Could you send me the file today?“. „I want to know“ — „Could you tell me…?“. „You are wrong“ — „I see it differently“. Va yana biri: „ASAP“ — mijozga emas, hamkasbingizga juda nodir; mijozga „at your earliest convenience“. Muloyimlik — zaiflik emas, professional kuch.
scenes.say: Not: Send me the file now. Say: Could you send me the file today? Not: I want to know. Say: Could you tell me? Not: You are wrong. Say: I see it differently. And avoid ASAP with clients.
scenes.say_uz: „Send me the file now“ demang. „Could you send me the file today?“ deb ayting. „I want to know“ demang. „Could you tell me?“ deb ayting. „You are wrong“ demang. „I see it differently“ deb ayting. Mijozga ASAP ishlatmang.

scenes.title: Professional vaziyatlar mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mashq qiling. Uchta jumla yozing: birinchisi — kechikish uchun uzr so‘rash; ikkinchisi — fikr so‘rash; uchinchisi — uchrashuvni keyinga surish taklifi. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I apologise for the delay. Could you give me some feedback? Could we push the meeting to Thursday?
scenes.say_uz: Kechikkanim uchun uzr. Menga fikr bera olasizmi? Uchrashuvni payshanbaga suramizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: professional vaziyatlar
board: Could you give me some feedback?
Could we push the meeting to Thursday?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Uzr — „I apologise for the delay“. Fikr so‘rash — „Could you give me some feedback?“. Surish taklifi — „Could we push the meeting to Thursday?“. Uchta jumla — yuzlab vaziyatni hal qiladi. Telaffuzingizni sokin va samimiy tuting.
scenes.say: I apologise for the delay. Could you give me some feedback? Could we push the meeting to Thursday? Three sentences, hundreds of situations.
scenes.say_uz: I apologise for the delay. Could you give me some feedback? Could we push the meeting to Thursday? Uchta jumla — yuzlab vaziyat.

scenes.title: Yakuniy test haqida
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy test. O‘n besh savol, to‘rtta variantdan bittasi to‘g‘ri. Savollar butun moduldan: grammatika va xatolar — artikllar, kelishuv, zamonlar; sozlashuv va muloyimlik; madaniyat — odob va mavzular; yozma til — e-mail va CV; intervyu tili. Har savoldan keyin „why“ tushuntirishini o‘qing — ular xatoni qaytarmaslikka yordam beradi. Vaqt shoshilinch emas — diqqat bilan o‘qing.
scenes.say: The final test: fifteen questions, four options each. They cover grammar and errors, politeness, culture, email and CV language, and interview basics. Read each why-explanation — they stop the mistakes from coming back.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy test: o‘n besh savol, har birida to‘rtta variant. Grammatika va xatolar, muloyimlik, madaniyat, e-mail va CV tili hamda intervyu asoslari qamraladi. Har savoldan keyin why tushuntirishini o‘qing — ular xatoning qaytishini to‘xtatadi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 3 daqiqalik intervyu
board: Tell me about a difficult problem you solved
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Telefoningizga uch daqiqalik intervyu javobini yozib oling: „Tell me about a difficult problem you solved at work“. STAR — vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija. Ikkita raqam ishlating: vaqt va natija. Tinch, tabiiy ohangda gapiring — tafakkur qilasiz, o‘qimaysiz. Yozuvni o‘zingiz tinglab, ovoz, urg‘u va STAR tuzilishini baholang.
scenes.say: Record a three-minute answer to: Tell me about a difficult problem you solved at work. Use STAR — situation, task, action, result. Include two numbers. Speak naturally, then listen back and judge your structure and delivery.
scenes.say_uz: „Tell me about a difficult problem you solved at work“ ga uch daqiqalik javobni yozib oling. STAR — vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija — ishlating. Ikki raqam kiriting. Tabiiy gapiring, keyin yozuvni tinglab, tuzilishingiz va yetkazib berishingizni baholang.

scenes.title: Namuna yakuniy loyiha
scenes.say_native: Namuna. „Last year our largest client threatened to leave after two late deliveries. I had to rebuild the onboarding process in one month. I mapped every handover, found two bottlenecks in documentation, and cut first-delivery time by a third. The client stayed, and we signed a two-year renewal worth forty percent of annual revenue.“ Vaziyat, vazifa, harakat, natija — ikki raqam bilan.
scenes.say: Last year our largest client threatened to leave after two late deliveries. I had to rebuild onboarding in one month. I mapped every handover, found two bottlenecks, and cut first-delivery time by a third. The client stayed — we signed a two-year renewal worth forty percent of our annual revenue.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili eng katta mijozimiz ikki kechikishdan keyin ketishni tahdid qildi. Bir oyda onboardingni qayta qurishim kerak edi. Har bir topshirishni xaritadim, ikkita tor joyni topdim va birinchi yetkazib berish vaqtini uchdan birga qisqartirdim. Mijoz qoldi — yillik daromadimizning qirq foiziga teng ikki yillik yangilanishni imzoladik.

scenes.title: PRO 1 xulosa
scenes.say_native: PRO 1 xulosasi. Xatolarni bilasiz va tuzatasiz. Talaffuz — kuchsiz shakllar, urg‘u, bog‘lanish — ishlaydi. Ishga ariza — CV, xat, intervyu STAR bilan. Telefon, e-mail va yig‘ilish tili — professional. Kundalik vaziyatlar — tabiiy. Yakuniy testdan qo‘rqmang: har savol darsda o‘tilgan material. O‘zingizni ishlatishingiz mumkin bo‘lgan ingliz tili — bu modulning g‘alabasi.
scenes.say: PRO 1 complete: errors fixed, pronunciation sharp, the full application set, phone, email and meeting English, and everyday professional language. The final test is built from everything you have learned.
scenes.say_uz: PRO 1 yakunlandi: xatolar tuzatildi, talaffuz aniq, to‘liq ariza to‘plami, telefon, e-mail va yig‘ilish ingliz tili, hamda kundalik professional til. Yakuniy test o‘rganganlaringizdan iborat.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi: yakuniy loyiha
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi — PRO 1 yakuniy loyihasi: bitta e’lon tanlang, CVingizni moslab yozing, cover letterni tayyorlang va uch daqiqalik intervyu javobini yozib oling — „Tell me about a difficult problem you solved“. Mezon: CV bir sahifa, xat uch paragraf, intervyu STAR bo‘yicha va ikki raqam bilan. Keyingi darsda PRO 2 boshlanadi — Professional muzokaralar: BATNA, anchoring va deadlock.
scenes.say: Final project: pick a job advert, tailor your CV and write the cover letter, then record a three-minute interview answer with STAR. See you in PRO 2 — professional negotiations.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy loyiha: bitta ish e’lonini tanlang, CVingizni moslang va cover letter yozing, keyin STAR bo‘yicha uch daqiqalik intervyu javobini yozib oling. PRO 2 da ko‘rishamiz — professional muzokaralar.

homework_uz: PRO 1 yakuniy loyihasini bajaring: (1) bitta haqiqiy ish e’lonini tanlang; (2) CVingizni e’longa moslab bir sahifada yozing; (3) cover letter — uch paragraf (ochilish, bitta raqamli misol, yakun); (4) uch daqiqalik intervyu javobini yozib oling — „Tell me about a difficult problem you solved“ — STAR bo‘yicha, ikki raqam bilan. Keyingi dars: Professional muzokaralar.
